notes.title: Die Young is now available on PlayStation 4

items.text: Firstly, Die Young is now available on the PlayStation Store. We know it may seem a bit odd to some for us to post an announcement here on Steam, but we simply couldn't contain our excitement and we wanted to share it with our fans, especially the ones who have been requesting this version for a while now.

Die Young is out now on PS4 in English, German, Hungarian, Italian, Polish, Russian, Spanish, Turkish (screen languages). For those lucky few who have managed to get a PS5...to play this game on PS5, your system may need to be updated to the latest system software. Although this game is playable on PS5, some features available on PS4 may be absent.
Unfortunately the US release will take place at the end of this month, but it is on its way nevertheless.
Secondly, we have not forgotten about our PC fans. Die Young just got updated on Steam. Here are the release notes:
Below is the changelog with the most important fixes, mainly stuff that we did for Ps4 submission but there are few nice goodies:
CHANGELOG ver 1.2.5
fix for a bug that didn't trigger Good Ending (player got stuck in the final arena after killing all enemies).
fix for a new exploit to Biofuel Refinery (allowed to collect the Fuel Can before having the Lighter, generating the Generator bug at the Radio Tower)
fix to animations dogs / wolves / Cujo (the rotations were broken)
fix farmer animations (animations were broken and some farmers skidded from one point to another in their paths)
AI perception fix (enemies were stuck indefinitely if they perceived a sound from an unreachable point)
Fix for junkie AI (remained motionless after taking a few hits)
fix for bug in The Collector shop (deleted some items, without giving them, if bought in case of full inventory)
fix for various graphic bugs
various fixes in level design: Enjoy!
Hi Everybody!
Today we are very proud to announce a majore release patch for Die Young.
1.0.30.20 where many things were added,
the most important are RUSSIAN and SPANISH languages!
Since its release the 12 of September, thousands of you played Die Young and we are very happy.
We are still finalizing Italian ( it's our native language so we want to make things right ;-) ) and it should be ready for next week when also official soundtrack will be released.
We also add Trading cards in this patch, we hope you like it!
Full changelog 1.0.30.20
added Russian language
added Spanish language
The executioner now despawns after crossing Underworld Passage
Now the Executioner keys (Blood-soaked Keys) also open the gates of the passage that directly connects Dry Riverbed and Stone Pillars.
fix of some quests that were not completed correctly
graphix fixes/ improvements on several textures
graphix fixes/ improvements on several npc animations
graphix fixes/ improvements on several first person animations
further level and geometry optimization.

Check here for more: http://www.milangamesweek.it/indie

This update focuses on increasing the overall experience in Downward, many others will follow. Hi Guys!
Finally, here we are! The Downward 1.0 version has been released and we are out from Early Access!

We are very proud of ourselves and, above all, we are proud of the Downward community that helped us so much in these six monts, allowing us to come out from EA (which not very common these days): thank you all!

So with Downward v1.0 among other things we have finally the full story and the three alternative endings (we can say the endings are "Dark Souls like", so please don't expect some "The Witcher" or "Mass Effect" stuff, we are a small indie team after all!!). Unlocking the two extra endings will allow you to discover the final lore elements about the different characters, and let you make different choices at the very end of the game.
Of course, we will continue the constant support to the game after the full release, not only to fix reported stuff etc. but also to keep some promises we made:
Linux full release build is our first duty, as promised we will work on this straightway.
Updating the demo, (the actual demo is quite old at the moment)
Fps optimization
Other minor adjustments: Thank you all,: Caracal Team

Hi!
A new, big update for Downward is now available!
With this update the adventure continues bringing you to the Deep Crater, a whole new area to explore where you will find a:
New anomaly to master, able to bend reality itself;
New planet to control, giving you the power to control heat;
New NPC;
New enemy to face;
Together with the progression to all the sub-quests, with items and secrets to discover!
As always, we are looking forward to all your comments and feedback, which will help us make the game always more interesting and fun!
Also, with this big update in place, now the full release is just a step ahead: look forward to it!
Best,

Hi!
With this update to v. 0.5 we introduce a lot of new features!
First, as we received many requests for it, we made a free demo available to anyone! To all of you who were just a bit curious, come give it a try!
Then we added a new, customizable area to the game!

You will now be able to access the Merchant’s Lair, an underground secret cove where you can study your enemies, prepare to explore, train and also… lay around! The place can be customized to satisfy your needs using Skypieces to furnish rooms or buy upgrades and gadgets.
Next, a big innovation for challenge-seeking players!
With this update, we introduce a global leaderboard system for time challenges!
We already know that some among you achieve very good times in the challenges… but are you ready to challenge the entire community?

Additionally, this update introduces the new voice acting. We gathered a lot of feedback to make the whole story feel more natural and interesting. We tried to let the main character’s personality come out more.
We hope you’ll like it!
Lastly, we introduced Trading Cards and Steam Achievements.
Try to collect them all!
Best,
Caracal Team
